nodes.summary: A code $c$ of a partial recursive function $\varphi_c$ on $\mathbb{N}$ is finite when the domain of $\varphi_c$, the set of inputs on which $c$ halts, is finite. The set of finite codes is denoted $\mathrm{FIN}$.
nodes.title: Codes with finite domain

nodes.summary: For a code $c$ of a partial recursive function, let $h_c$ be the partial function on $\mathbb{N}$ that on input $j$ outputs $0$ if $c$ halts on input $0$ within $j$ steps (the step-bounded evaluation of $c$ on input $0$ with bound $j$ returns a value) and is undefined otherwise. Then for every $k \in \mathbb{N}$, $h_c$ is defined at $k$ if and only if $c$ halts on input $0$ within $k$ steps.
nodes.title: Domain of the halts-within function

nodes.summary: For a code $c$ of a partial recursive function, $h_c$ is the partial function on $\mathbb{N}$ that on input $k$ outputs $0$ if $c$ halts on input $0$ within $k$ steps (the step-bounded evaluation of $c$ on input $0$ with bound $k$ returns a value) and is undefined otherwise.
nodes.title: Halts-within function

nodes.summary: The set of codes of partial recursive functions that halt on input $0$ is many-one reducible to the set of finite codes: there is a computable function $f$ from codes to codes such that, for every code $c$, $c$ halts on input $0$ if and only if the partial function of $f(c)$ has finite domain.
nodes.title: Halting reduces to finiteness

nodes.summary: The set of codes of partial recursive functions that do not halt on input $0$ is many-one reducible to the set of finite codes: there is a computable function $f$ from codes to codes such that, for every code $c$, $c$ does not halt on input $0$ if and only if the partial function of $f(c)$ has finite domain.
nodes.title: Non-halting reduces to finiteness

nodes.summary: The set of codes of partial recursive functions with finite domain is not co-recognizable by multi-stack Turing machines: no finite multi-stack machine whose input alphabet is identified with $\{0, 1\}$ halts on the binary encoding of the number of a code $c$ exactly when the partial function of $c$ has infinite domain.
nodes.title: Finiteness is not co-recognizable

nodes.summary: The set of codes of partial recursive functions with finite domain is not decidable by multi-stack Turing machines: there is no total function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ computed by a finite multi-stack machine on binary encodings such that, for every code $c$ with number $n_c$, $f(n_c) = 1$ if and only if the partial function of $c$ has finite domain.
nodes.title: Finiteness is undecidable

nodes.summary: The set of codes of partial recursive functions with finite domain is not recognizable by multi-stack Turing machines: no finite multi-stack machine whose input alphabet is identified with $\{0, 1\}$ halts on the binary encoding of the number of a code $c$ exactly when the partial function of $c$ has finite domain.
nodes.title: Finiteness is not recognizable

nodes.summary: For a code $c$ of a partial recursive function, let $u_c$ be the partial function on $\mathbb{N}$ that on input $j$ is undefined if $c$ halts on input $0$ within $j$ steps (the step-bounded evaluation of $c$ on input $0$ with bound $j$ returns a value) and outputs $0$ otherwise. Then for every $k \in \mathbb{N}$, $u_c$ is defined at $k$ if and only if $c$ does not halt on input $0$ within $k$ steps.
nodes.title: Domain of the until-halts function

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
